groups.defect: Eager constructor initialization blocks on index building and makes initialization errors fatal to startup, including existing file-index directory collisions on restarts or multiple server constructions.
groups.rationale: Both explicitly report the constructor's newly fatal handling of initialization errors. The merged comment must also preserve the blocking-contract concern and the specific persistent-index collision scenarios.

groups.defect: TotalDocs iterates the cache without its mutex while the startup event goroutine can concurrently insert an index, causing fatal concurrent map access.
groups.rationale: These describe the identical race from the new TotalDocs call site and the cache write site. Synchronizing the TotalDocs read resolves both.
